svg.title: The record table: 48 records of 16 bytes
svg.desc: A schematic of the 768-byte record table at $0E00, with one record expanded to label all sixteen bytes.
svg.text: The record table: 48 records of 16 bytes
768 bytes at $0E00-$10FF. Byte 0 sorts every record; the rest is state.
$00-$3F live, low six bits index the type tables
(shown plain so the grid stays readable)
each row is one record; memory runs down a column, then across
Byte 0: bits 7-6 are state ($80 free, $40 dying); bits 5-0 pick the type row in $C39A.
